curation_notes: Curated excerpt, not an unmodified raw export. Numerical values retain source precision.
Source reports remain local; hashes bind this excerpt to the audited files but are not a public archive or a signature.

board.metadata_source: Configured board registry captured in the experiment manifest, not independent clock verification.
board.name: Xilinx Kria KV260

limitations: Kria uses the raw one2one head, quantized-space thresholding and CPU top-k without NMS. Kaggle exports identify one2many plus NMS; this is not an isolated FP32-to-INT8 quantization-loss experiment.

Performance results come only from the two accuracy-disabled runs. Their application FPS includes image reads, worker startup and pipeline drain, excludes model/OpenCV initialization, and discards no warmup frames.
All runs disable drawing/saving. No annotated images are exported.
DPU latency is VART execute_async plus wait, not pure kernel or DMA time. Stages overlap and accumulate worker elapsed time; wall_pct is not utilization.
Power is SOM-total power, not GPU-only power. Idle fallback/unavailability are retained explicitly. Energy/image uses average power / application FPS.

Accuracy uses the repository's score-ordered class-aware greedy matching and 101-recall-level AP evaluator, not the Ultralytics evaluator. P/R use matching IoU=0.5; AP spans IoU=0.50:0.05:0.95. F1 is harmonic(macro P, macro R).

Accuracy-run FPS includes online label loading/matching but excludes final AP aggregation, so do not use it as deployment performance. Process time in the manifest covers the entire CLI including final aggregation.
These are sequential single passes over 5000 images, not repeated-run statistics. Filesystem caches and thermal state are not reset between runs.
The test subset and source/model artifacts are user-supplied, not distributed with this excerpt.
The configured 300 MHz DPU clock and four-runner software limit are metadata, not measured utilization.
No thermal telemetry, cache reset, repeated-run uncertainty, controlled FP32/INT8 parity or baseline/Fast Finetune ablation is established.

timing_notes: Application FPS includes worker startup, image loading, enabled accuracy/drawing/saving, and pipeline drain; model loading and main-thread OpenCV initialization are excluded. No warmup images are excluded. runner_setup records runner/buffer/cache creation.

Stage totals sum elapsed time across workers. Parent/child stages overlap; wall_pct is thread elapsed time / application wall time and can exceed 100%. It is not CPU or DPU utilization or an exclusive bottleneck share.
Decoder layout/concat stages are per image; threshold/dequant/class-score/box-decode stages are per pyramid level (survivor-dependent), not per image.

Queue waits include dequeue of the end-of-stream sentinel; frame totals exclude sentinels. producer_total includes read/preprocess/enqueue; consumer_total excludes input wait but includes enabled accuracy/drawing/output enqueue. postprocess includes decode_total/detection_postprocess.
The NumPy VART API does not expose separate cache/DMA synchronization timing; dpu measures execute_async plus wait, not pure hardware compute.
